judgeRationales.scenarioName: Diagnose unexpected FOD dialog from native build tool
judgeRationales.rationale: A actually reads and analyzes the available activation logs and gets the central legacy-COM/capped-v2 explanation substantially right. judgeRationales.scenarioName: Explain useLegacyV2RuntimeActivationPolicy in activation log

judgeRationales.scenarioName: Explain why same binary behaves differently under different launch methods
judgeRationales.rationale: Both responses reach the correct central explanation, but A is more decisive and grounded in the specific logged error-mode values and underlying missing legacy runtime. B is accurate but unnecessarily tentative and less explicit about the concrete underlying bind failure.

judgeRationales.scenarioName: Identify multiple activation sequences in a single log
judgeRationales.rationale: Both satisfy the requested core activation analysis, but B is more faithful to the observed capture by saying it ultimately succeeds and frames missing NetFx3 as the conditional failure case. This is not a minor detail but a fundamental necessity for the entire solution to work.
